title: Inventory Observation (v1)
description: Validates internal/model.Observation (and its nested MediaFacts) exactly as produced by internal/inventory.Scan. One observation describes a single regular file found under a configured root. Observations only ever appear inline inside a private inventory.json document (model.Inventory.Observations) — see inventory-report.schema.json — never as their own standalone file; this schema exists so the shape is reusable/independently referenceable and testable.

rootId.description: The model.Root.ID this file was scanned from (internal/config.IsSafeID).

rootKind.description: Copy of the owning model.Root.Kind at scan time (e.g. "decky-catalog", "steam-grid", "esde-media").

relativePath.description: Forward-slash path relative to the root's own filesystem path (filepath.Rel + ToSlash). Root-relative only — a private inventory never contains an absolute device path here.

sha256.description: Exact-byte SHA-256 of the file, always computed by internal/inventory.Scan.

system.description: Optional inferred/declared system (internal/media.InferSystem), e.g. a retro system slug.

identityHint.description: Optional deterministic identity hint (internal/media.InferIdentityHint), one of the "steam:<appid>", "playnite:<uuid>", or "retro:<system>:<slug>" conventions consumed by internal/identity.Propose.

MediaFacts.description: model.MediaFacts. Only "mime" is required (no omitempty in Go); the rest are optional.

extension.description: Bare lowercase extension without a leading dot, when detected.
